reading.zh-CN: 地图能帮助我们认识地方，但不同年代的地图可能不一样。这里是一幅想象地图，我们不把它当成过去真实的城市。
reading.en: Maps help us learn about places. Maps can change over time. This is an imagined map, not a real old city map.

text.zh-CN: 地图上的符号代表不同的地方。先看图例，再找你要去的地方。
text.en: Symbols on a map stand for places. Read the key, then find your place.

reading.zh-CN: 我在找一块路牌。请和我一起往右走。屏幕的左右不是地图的东西，要先看方向标记。
reading.en: I am looking for a sign. Walk to the right with me. Right on the screen does not always mean east on a map. Check the directions first.

text.zh-CN: 东、西、南、北可以帮助我们描述方向。地图可能旋转，先确认北方在哪里。
text.en: East, west, south and north help us give directions. A map can turn. Check where north is first.

reading.zh-CN: 我在收集过去与现在的词语。向左走，我们想到过去；向右走，我们回到现在。这些故事是想象，不是这座城市的历史记录。
reading.en: I collect words about then and now. We walk left to think about the past and right to return to now. These stories are imagined, not records of this city.

text.zh-CN: 过去是已经发生的时间。了解一个地方的过去，要寻找有日期和来源的记录，不能只看想象的画面。
text.en: The past is time that has already happened. To learn about a place, look for dated records and sources, not just imagined pictures.
